marketing_description: The DeWALT DCN930P1 Framing Nailer offers cordless convenience and delivers powerful performance in a wide range of applications, minimizing downtime between shots with its innovative flywheel that stays active for 6 seconds after the trigger is released. This tool features a brushless motor and can complete up to 100 ft. of wall framing per charge, and install up to 530 sqft of subflooring per charge. It provides a convenient solution for framing pros, removing the need for hoses and compressors.
